name: inspect_android_class
description: Inspect one exact Android class's parsed methods, fields and inner classes, including synthetic members. Returns display signatures, exact DEX prototypes and encoded static final field values without generating source. A prototype is not a complete raw method ID; overload indices remain consistent within the artifact and engine session. Optional mapping_path annotates observed raw DEX names with R8/ProGuard mapped names in a separate mapping block, verified by DEX type or prototype; observed names stay primary. Select detail summary to retain complete Evidence and return these normalized symbols without duplicate raw provider calls; omitted or complete detail preserves the complete inline response.
